subject_line: Application for MERN Stack Developer - Ayushkumar Burde
body:
I am applying for the MERN Stack Developer position. My background includes building responsive web interfaces and RESTful APIs using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. I have delivered production applications with JWT authentication and asynchronous request handling.

I have experience with the full product development lifecycle, including database schema design and unit testing. Please review the attached resume for details on my projects, including a Notes App and Resume AI tools.

Let me know if you have time for a brief call.
